question: How can even a wise person be afflicted at the source of nectar by burning essence?
premises: The location is described as the tip of nectar.
Even a wise person is affected.
inference: Therefore even the wise may be burned at the nectar-source by this potent essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referent of amṛta+agraṃ is context-dependent in yogic texts.
plain_english: Even a wise person is burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of the juice.
